mentions.note: late Belgrave long distance walker of the 1930s and 1940s; member of winning London to Brighton teams; became a Centurion in the 1946 24 hours track walk at the White City; killed on Police motor cycle patrol

share.d: R. (Jock) Martin in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1980: 1 mention in 1 issue.
